title: DirectorSession
description: The per-chapter DECISION RECORD of the Narrative Director (roadmap Phase 7.2). It captures, for one chapter, the director's chain of control: which ChapterObjective drove the draft, which DirectorBrief instructed it, which critique/rewrite-decision/version-comparison/version-selection (if any) followed, which draft was selected, and the rationale. It replaces the ad-hoc `director` dict Phase 6 attached in execution.run with a schema-backed, auditable artifact. Like commercial-session and revision-session, it RIDES THE RUNTIME ENVELOPE beside the draft, never inside the frozen ChapterDraft schema (whose additionalProperties is false). It is a read-side provenance record: the director plans and selects, but generation stays behind the Model seam (runtime/director/ writes no facts and imports no model, fitness guard #21). Two structural invariants: `gating` const false — a director session NEVER blocks a build (ADR-003); it is advisory production provenance. `authority` const human — internal draft selection may be automatic (the Commercial Loop precedent), but the outward transitions this record informs (publish, mint) stay a human decision (ADR-009), never triggered by this artifact.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the director records its decisions; it never auto-executes an outward/irreversible transition (publish, mint).

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): a director session NEVER blocks a build. It is advisory production provenance.

pins.description: Provenance pins so the session can be reproduced/aligned: the inner draft content_hash it selected, the state cursor, the prompt version.
